about: Stages and timing for the search-demand-to-revenue playbook. scripts/handoff.py reads this file: the stages it tracks, the outcomes each stage can record, and how long to wait between stages. Each key is explained under notes.

stages.name: find
stages.do: Find the rising and new searches, add the ones worth acting on as findings, and ask the user which one to take forward.

stages.name: triage
stages.do: For a search that fails shoppers, work out why: a synonym or spelling fix, a catalog gap, a redirect candidate or noise.

skip_when.reason: the find stage found no search worth acting on.
the search already finds and sells products: there's no dead end to triage.

stages.name: fix
stages.do: Make the synonym the triage found, switched off first and on after its own yes.

skip_when.reason: the triage was skipped: the search already sells, or there's nothing to act on.
the triage found no synonym fix: a catalog gap, a redirect or noise.

stages.name: collection
stages.do: Define the landing collection for the search, so the campaign links to a page that returns products. Skip it when a page that returns the right products already exists.

skip_when.reason: the find stage found no search worth acting on.
the search is noise: nothing to fix or promote.

stages.name: campaign
stages.do: Size who searched for it and recommend a campaign; create an email or SMS draft only if the user asks, after its own yes.

skip_when.reason: the find stage found no search worth acting on.
the search is noise: nothing to fix or promote.

stages.name: digest
stages.do: Read how the campaign did once a person has sent it. Record never_sent when the draft won't be sent.

skip_when.reason: no draft was created, so there's no send to read.

stages.name: measure
stages.do: Check whether the site fix (or, without one, the campaign launch) moved the search's revenue, with the change and its date from the hand-off file. Skip it when neither happened.

skip_when.reason: the find stage found no search worth acting on.
the search is noise: nothing to fix or promote.
nothing changed: no synonym went live and no campaign was made.
nothing changed: no synonym went live and the campaign was never sent.

notes.digest_after_days: Days after the campaign stage finishes (the draft exists) before the digest stage is due. engagement-campaign-digest reads a whole week by default; when the user gives the send date, the digest is due this many days after it (record it with stage --not-before).
notes.measure_after_days: Days after the fix stage finishes before the measure stage is due. change-impact-tracker needs about 14 days of data after a change for a verdict other than too early to tell. When there's no site fix and the campaign launch is measured, count from the send date instead (stage --not-before).
notes.wait_outcomes: Outcomes that mean a stage isn't finished yet: the campaign hasn't been sent, or the change needs more data. The script records them only with status in_progress and a --not-before date to come back on. The digest stage's never_sent is the final outcome for a draft that won't be sent, so a run doesn't wait on not_sent_yet for ever.
notes.playbooks: Each playbook's title, product and stages in order. A stage names the skill that does it, whether that skill writes, which product it needs in a run on both (product), what to do, the outcomes it can record, not_before (wait this rules key's number of days after another stage is done) and skip_when (suggest skipping when another stage had one of these outcomes, or was skipped). A run without Engagement gets the campaign and digest stages offered for skipping. A skip_when entry with all lists conditions that must every one hold; a condition with both outcomes and skipped: true holds for either. The measure stage is offered as a skip when nothing changed: no synonym went live, and the campaign wasn't made or never sent.
